ache.title: “A pivotal week for your account” is pressure
ache.note: Past-Nero called this a pivotal week with four 5-stars on the banners, then lined up Jiaoqiu, Sparkle, Robin, Feixiao, Kafka and Light Cones. Four at once is built to make every option feel essential. Words like “critical decisions” make a game feel like a job interview. It isn’t.
watch: Light Cones as an extra must-have
ache.tip: If every option feels essential, none of them are. Skip this patch and see if your fun changes at all.
lines: pivotal week? it’s just a week
four banners, one you. no contest
he made a game feel like taxes. oops

Patch 2.5 Part 1 introduces an unprecedented scenario with four Five Star units on the banners. In this video, I’ll guide you through the options and provide strategies for building strong archetypes, from choosing essential supports like Jiaoqiu, Sparkle, and Robin, to deciding on crucial DPS units like Feixiao and Kafka. Let’s navigate the complexities of Patch 2.5 together and set you on the path to success!
